interpretation: Gen 9 against BEN (64). 9a-32 reads BEN as 8p-32 does (no model for BEN). Compare with Gen 8 against BEN (64) (campaign gen8-candidate-ben-20261112).
model_note: Gen 9 (9a-32) is the Gen 8 prototype (8p-32: Gen 7.1 standard with the play read from trick 1 at exponent 1.0, policy v4.1) reading each partnership through a player model: house bots are modelled as the house system, so the auction is read by replaying the house bidder after the opening lead; BEN and anyone without a model are read exactly as 8p-32 reads them. It plays a random one of its exactly equal-best cards (exploration 1.0). No experience is carried: the models are what each side declares. 8p-32 is the control. 8s-32 and 71s-32 are the arena's Gen 8 and Gen 7.1 (same identities). docs/gen9/cohort.md.

difference_definition.unit: IMPs per board, candidate minus opponent
difference_definition.bidding: Native minus common on the same board; includes auction/play interaction
difference_definition.uncertainty: Student-t intervals on paired per-board differences; exploratory, unadjusted for repeated monitoring
